description: Glass inset row that opens the native DateTimePicker for the budget start date. Same visual recipe as FormField but taps to a picker instead of a text input. Preserves the exact iOS/Android platform branching.
behavior: Value = value.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month:'long', day:'numeric', year:'numeric' }). iOS: DateTimePicker display='spinner', themeVariant='dark', followed by a Done pill that calls onClose. Android: display='calendar', auto-dismiss on change (onClose then onChange). Preserve current platform branches exactly.

accessibility.label: Start date, {formatted date}, opens date picker
accessibility.reducedMotion: No entrance animation required; native picker handles its own
